name: io.github.PasiutusVovere/tickerrisk-mcp
title: TickerRisk
description: Check options trades for hidden catalysts (earnings, FDA, legal, SEC) before you sell premium.

environmentVariables.name: TICKERRISK_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional JWT for an existing TickerRisk account. Without it, anonymous access applies: full access for 24 hours, then a free account extends it.

environmentVariables.name: TICKERRISK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API host. Defaults to https://tickerrisk.com
